title: Trove environment geo-event
description: One line of environment/<source>/events/YYYY-MM.jsonl: a located, dated hazard/phenomenon event — earthquake, wildfire detection, weather or geomagnetic alert. event_type is an open vocabulary (additive). Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local time the event occurred (quake origin time, detection acquisition, alert onset)

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

guid.description: source-unique id (USGS event id, alert id, detection hash) — the dedupe key; required for geo-events

event_type.description: open vocabulary: quake | fire | alert | … (new types arrive additively without a new folder)

magnitude.description: quake magnitude (or any scalar intensity the event carries)

place.description: human place description ("12km NE of Ojai, CA", the alert area)

examples: Red Flag Warning issued June 10 at 11:00AM PDT until June 11 at 8:00PM PDT

url.description: canonical link to the event page

expires.description: RFC3339 local; when an alert stops being active

extra.description: everything source-specific (depth_km, tsunami flag, felt reports, fire confidence/FRP/satellite, …)
